New protocol: everyone in a session needs 0.10.0 (it doesn't play with 0.9.2)
Shared storage (experimental, host setting bSharedStorage): one copy of each home or settlement container for everyone
Give items by putting them in a chest (experimental, host setting bContainerGifts)
Borrow a friend's parked power armor frame, pieces and core included
Optional crawl while downed and autosave on going down (host settings bDownedCrawl, bSaveOnDown)
NPCs stay alive, hit and owned the same in every game; no more passing an NPC back and forth
Script-opened doors, the Prydwen's arrival and knocked clutter match in every game
The host can bring in what a friend built before the session (bShareGuestBuilds)
Friends move, holster and wear power armor more like they do in their own game
The dedicated server retries a failed save and takes the new host rules as options
Many stability fixes for saves, loads, explosions and copies of frames
Full notes on GitHub
